name: Herat
registryBasis: Herat Municipality reports that its citywide IFMS supports municipal sanitation/charges for properties, processing related documents, and property registration in urban nawahi. MUDL separately reports 4,595 property deeds distributed to residents of informal areas of Herat city. These city-specific sources establish municipal property registration and an informal-settlement registration program, but not complete private-parcel coverage or public geometry.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: Herat Municipality’s English, Dari and Pashto map pages embed the same static 1600×1110 JPEG city map. It has a scale bar but no georeferenced parcel polygons, GIS client, or geometry endpoint. City-specific IFMS and informal-settlement property-registration sources confirm registry activity but disclose no public parcel feature service. No complete polygon geometry was retrieved.
scopeLimits: The Herat Municipality IFMS evidence concerns municipal property registration and sanitation-charge administration in urban nawahi; the MUDL deeds evidence concerns informal areas of Herat city. Neither establishes complete private-parcel coverage or a public feature service. The separate MUDL state-land report is province-level and is not used as evidence of citywide private cadastre.
remainingUncertainty: The WUP locator and parcels near it remain unverified. The IFMS scope is municipal property registration/charge administration in urban nawahi, and the MUDL deed report is limited to informal areas; neither establishes complete private-parcel coverage. Other non-public or unindexed registry systems may exist.

officialSources.observation: Official Dari Herat Municipality report (2019) states that the city IFMS digitizes property sanitation/municipal-charge distribution, financial/administrative paperwork, and property registration in urban nawahi. This is city-specific property-registry evidence, not a published parcel geometry source.

Official MUDL Dari Herat category page reports 4,595 property deeds distributed to residents of informal areas of Herat city under an urban informal-settlement registration program (2021). Scope is the covered informal areas, not all private parcels.
MUDL report dated 2020 describes survey and registration of state-owned land in western Herat Province; retained only as province/state-land context, not as citywide private-parcel evidence.
Official English municipal map page embeds a single static image titled “Herat City Map” and asks users to download or zoom it.
Dari Herat Municipality planning-office notice says the office provides urban-plan and technical map guidance to visitors; it does not publish a parcel geometry endpoint.
Official Dari page lists informational files for the 15 urban districts; no parcel geometry format or map service was identified in the page content.
Official Pashto municipal notice describes a service center for building-plan licensing; it is not a public parcel-map service.
